label: EXPLORATORY (option 2 of results/icit_plate_check_2026-11-06.md). Not a pre-registered test of ICIT accuracy.
statement: Mackay vol. II plate LXXXII (upper levels) labels 18 seals (687-704) by area: 687-692 under 'H. Section, DK Area' and 693-704 under 'SD. Section, Stupa Area'. Count the Mohenjo-daro seal objects in the merged ICIT corpus whose area-section falls in those two areas (DK prefix, SD prefix), and report the counts. No accuracy claim is made.
statistic: Counts of ICIT Mohenjo-daro seal objects by area-section prefix (DK, SD), and the number of plate seals per area. Reported as counts only.
null: None. This is descriptive. The count is not compared with a null and no significance is claimed.
falsifier: If ICIT has no Mohenjo-daro seal objects with a DK or SD area-section, the area mapping cannot be used for any ICIT-to-plate match, and option 2 is reported as failed.
controls: Site fixed to Mohenjo-daro. Object type fixed to seals (type starting SEAL). Plate seals are not read in this step; no signs are compared.
status: Written and hashed before the ICIT area count was run. Results: results/icit_area_count_2026-11-07.md. Reader: Claude, single reader. Does not enter the corpus.
